invariants.rationale: context is required for engine operations in this method and all similar methods.
cleanInstantTime must be non-null to represent an instant on which to clean.
cleanInstantTime should not be an empty string if it represents a valid time.
cleanInstantTime should contain at least one non-whitespace character to be a valid instant.
context parameter is expected to be an instance of HoodieEngineContext as enforced by type signature.
